mapper.sql: id, user_id, activity_id, check_in_status, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_registration (user_id, activity_id, check_in_status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{activityId}, 'NOT_CHECKED_IN')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM activity_registration WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND activity_id = #{activityId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM activity_registration WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM activity_registration WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM activity_registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()

SELECT a.id activity_id, r.user_id, u.phone, a.title, a.activity_start FROM activity_registration r JOIN community_activity a ON a.id=r.activity_id JOIN `user` u ON u.id=r.user_id WHERE r.deleted=0 AND a.deleted=0 AND a.activity_start >= #{start} AND a.activity_start < #{end}
